title: [VSC-25] VS Code Accounts view: one copy of shell quoting and account text, and rows while disconnected so CLI sign-in (corpus C09) is reachable
description:
Filed by VSC-18 (task-43363b5d) from its adversarial pass over the epic diff.
1. Duplicated helpers. src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts carries copies of psQuote, shQuote and assertSafeArg from src/util/AgentLauncher.ts. Its comment says this is because the provider loads under closed require maps in the tests. task-2f4b224f had to fix both VS Code copies plus the Kotlin one. It also has a second account-text table, ACCOUNT_ACTION_TEXT, with its own resolver `say`, beside AccountPresentation.ACCOUNT_TEXT and resolveAccountText. The two key sets are disjoint and both are pinned to the bundle. The comments at the accountsCommandLine JSDoc and in runCli still say 'throws on CR, LF or NUL', but the code refuses every C0 control and DEL. Open question for the planner: move the quoting into one pure module, such as util/shellQuote.ts with no imports, and add it to the strict require maps of the affected tests; or keep the copies and add a test that holds them byte-identical. Pick one.
2. A C09 parity gap (VSC-14/15 QA). While disconnected, the view shows a single state item and no rows. JetBrains keeps Sign in available through the CLI when there is a cli but no connection (client-accounts.json C09), so in VS Code that action is unreachable.
definitionOfDone: Either one copy of psQuote/shQuote/assertSafeArg serves AgentLauncher.ts and AccountsTreeProvider.ts, or a test holds the copies identical; the stale 'CR, LF or NUL' comments are corrected; tests/powershell-quoting.test.cjs and tests/agent-launcher-controls.test.cjs stay green unchanged.
Account action text uses one resolver (AccountPresentation.resolveAccountText) or a test explains why two remain; every action string stays equal to MoeBundle.properties.
With a cached rotation that has a cli but no connection, the view lists rows and Sign in runs the CLI as in corpus row C09, with a test; the disconnected state item stays for the no-rotation case.
In a git-archive snapshot, moe-vscode `npm ci && npm run lint && npm run compile && npm test` exits 0.

implementationPlan.description:
1. Tests first (RED). Edit with the Edit tool only, and work in a scratch snapshot for runs.

Decision on the description's open question, item 1: KEEP the copies and add a test that holds them identical. A shared util/shellQuote.ts cannot work, for two reasons:
- DoD 1 pins tests/powershell-quoting.test.cjs and tests/agent-launcher-controls.test.cjs unchanged.
- Both of those load AgentLauncher.ts with `require: name => name === 'vscode' ? vscode : deps[name] || require(name)` (deps holds only '../services/MoeDaemonClient'). powershell-quoting also loads AccountsTreeProvider.ts with a closed map ('vscode', '../util/AccountPresentation'). Any new runtime import in either file throws in those loaders.
- `import type` is erased, so it is fine.

tests/accounts-actions.test.cjs:
(a) New test 'Q2'. Parse src/util/AgentLauncher.ts and src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts with `ts.createSourceFile(file, text, ts.ScriptTarget.ES2020, true)`. Collect the top-level FunctionDeclaration statements named psQuote, shQuote and assertSafeArg; a name declared twice is an assertion failure. Then:
  - assert the launcher has exactly those three;
  - assert `deepEqual(providerTexts, launcherTexts)` using `node.getText(sourceFile)`, which excludes leading comments, so the comments may differ.
  - RED today: the provider's psQuote and shQuote are arrow consts.
(b) New test 'C09'. Run `setup(rowOf('C09').rotation, { connected: false })`, then check:
  - getChildren() ids equal the row's expectRows ids;
  - the selected row's contextValue tokens equal `expected(row.expectActions)`;
  - canAdd and canSwitchAt equal expectActions.add and .switchAt (both false);
  - signIn on the selected node runs exactly `login <id>` (assertTerminal);
  - moveUp, moveDown and rename send nothing and open no dialog, and add opens no input box;
  - after `client.accountRotation = undefined` plus a connection event, the only item is t('moe.accounts.notConnected').
  - RED today: disconnected shows one state item.
(c) Rewrite 'S1':
  - `assert.equal(mod.ACCOUNT_ACTION_TEXT, undefined)`, and the provider source matches neither `ACCOUNT_ACTION_TEXT` nor `\bsay\(`;
  - each of the 11 dialog keys (add.title, add.prompt, rename.title, rename.prompt, remove.confirm, remove.signOut, remove.only, terminal.tab, terminal.unavailable, switchAt, switchAt.unit) equals `presentation.ACCOUNT_TEXT[key]` and the bundle value from `bundle.get(key)` (already `\n`-decoded);
  - keep the missing-terminal clipboard part as is.
(d) K2: update its comment `(VSC-14 lists no rows then)`. C09's rows are now listed and their tokens checked; the loop itself needs no change.

tests/accounts-view.test.cjs, V3:
- For 'disconnected' and 'connecting', `setup(c05, { connectionState }).provider.getChildren()` must deep-equal the connected `setup(c05)` children. Both use the corpus clock. This mirrors JetBrains AccountsPanel.render, which lists rows from the cached rotation whatever the connection.
- For each of those states, with `setup(undefined, { connectionState, isStateReady })` for both isStateReady values, the only item is notConnected.
- Keep the rest of V3.
- Extend V5 so every hostile rotation it feeds also renders while disconnected without throwing (parts() now parses the rotation on that path too).

tests/accounts-corpus.test.cjs, bundleValues():
- Decode `\n` exactly as accounts-actions does: `m[2].replace(/\\n/g, '\n')`. moe.accounts.terminal.unavailable joins ACCOUNT_TEXT in step 2 and holds a properties `\n`. No existing ACCOUNT_TEXT or corpus key contains one.

Focused RED run, in a whole-repo snapshot (the tests read ../moe-jetbrains):
`S=$(mktemp -d /mnt/d/moe-scratch/vsc25-red.XXXXXX) && git -C /mnt/d/projexts/moes archive HEAD | tar -x -C "$S"`
Then copy the three test files in, and from $S/moe-vscode run `npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && node --test tests/accounts-actions.test.cjs tests/accounts-view.test.cjs tests/accounts-corpus.test.cjs`.
Expected RED: Q2, C09, S1 and V3 fail on assertions, and the corpus test stays green.

error handling: every new assertion names its row, key or file, so a failure says which copy or text drifted.

Corpus test stays green; V5's new disconnected guards pass vacuously until the view lists rows. Kept the copies (no shared module) per the plan. Shared checkout had unrelated dirty paths (board json, roles, scripts); not touched.

implementationPlan.description:
2. Implementation (Edit tool only). AgentLauncher.ts is NOT edited.

src/util/AccountPresentation.ts:
- Move the 11 dialog entries of the provider's ACCOUNT_ACTION_TEXT into ACCOUNT_TEXT, byte-for-byte. remove.confirm keeps its {0}; terminal.unavailable keeps its real newline before {0}.
- Update the doc comment above ACCOUNT_TEXT to say it also holds the Accounts view's dialog text.
- None of the values contains a single quote, which accounts-corpus forbids because of MessageFormat.

src/providers/AccountsTreeProvider.ts:
(a) Replace the arrow-const psQuote and shQuote and the compact assertSafeArg with text-identical copies of AgentLauncher.ts's three `function` declarations: same signatures, bodies and line breaks.
  - Put one comment above them: they are byte-identical copies of AgentLauncher.ts's helpers, and accounts-actions Q2 holds them equal.
  - The comment must say why a shared module is not possible: powershell-quoting.test.cjs and agent-launcher-controls.test.cjs load both files under closed require maps and must stay unchanged.
  - Keep the existing why-comments: C0 and DEL because sendText types into a line editor; the PowerShell single quotes.
(b) Delete ACCOUNT_ACTION_TEXT and `say`. Every dialog text goes through the existing `text(key, ...args)`, i.e. resolveAccountText.
  - Leave NOT_CONNECTED, LABEL_HINT, PERCENT_HINT and the 'Account action failed:' prefix as they are: they are not bundle keys.
(c) parts() (C09, JetBrains AccountsPanel.render parity):
  - Drop the early not-connected return.
  - Parse the rotation first.
  - When it is null, return the single item `text(this.connected() && this.client.isStateReady ? 'moe.accounts.unsupported' : 'moe.accounts.notConnected')`.
  - Otherwise build rows, chips and the message exactly as today, connected or not.
  - Row tokens already come from actions(rotation, id, this.connected()). While disconnected that leaves only CLI actions: Sign in, and Remove with only 'Sign out and remove'. canAdd and canSwitchAt are off.
(d) Correct the stale comments, the accountsCommandLine JSDoc and runCli's `// throws on CR, LF or NUL`, to say a C0 control or DEL. Update the class doc: rows from the latest rotation even while disconnected, one state item when there is no rotation.

Keep exactly two imports: 'vscode' and '../util/AccountPresentation' (the type import is fine). accountsCommandLine stays exported, because powershell-quoting V2 calls it.

error handling:
- parts() stays total: parseAccountRotation, rows and chips never throw, and V5 now pins that while disconnected too.
- Action failures still go through guard().
- runCli still returns early for a null rotation or cli.

GREEN: rerun step 1's focused command, then all three files plus powershell-quoting.test.cjs and agent-launcher-controls.test.cjs in the snapshot. All tests pass.

implementationPlan.description:
4. Adversarial self-review (load adversarial-self-review), then complete_task.

Mutants, one at a time in the step-3 snapshot (edit the SNAPSHOT copy; restore each), each run with `node --test` on the named files:
- M1: drop U+201B from the provider's psQuote character class → Q2 fails (and powershell-quoting V2).
- M2: in the provider's assertSafeArg, change `code === 0x7f` to `code === 0x7e` → Q2 fails.
- M3: put back `if (this.client.connectionState !== 'connected') { return { items: [{ label: text('moe.accounts.notConnected') }] }; }` at the top of parts() → C09 and V3 fail.
- M4: drop `this.connected() &&` from the no-rotation branch → V3 fails (disconnected + isStateReady true would show 'unsupported').
- M5: change one character of 'moe.accounts.remove.only' in ACCOUNT_TEXT → S1 and the corpus bundle check fail.
Each kill must be an assertion on the named test, never a load or harness error.

Then check:
- Parity: re-read JetBrains AccountsPanel.render and confirm the same three states (rows from any rotation; UNSUPPORTED only when connected with state; else NOT_CONNECTED). Confirm the message logic (error, then noCli) is unchanged.
- Stale menus still re-check before acting.
- The provider imports only vscode and AccountPresentation, and AgentLauncher.ts has no diff.
- No value in ACCOUNT_TEXT has a single quote.
- Run `git diff --numstat` on the five files: under about 150 net lines.

Finish:
- If bytes change, re-run step 3.
- Call complete_task with step 3's command, exitCode and outputTail.
- Report modifiedFiles as exactly the five files.
- The summary carries the test counts, the RED list from step 1 and the mutant kills.
- Note for VSC-27 (task-e1024bb3), which builds on this row: the quoting copies stay two, held identical by Q2. A change to one copy must be made to both.

This step adds no error handling of its own; any failure loops back to step 3.
